instruction: Create a document containing all slide text from the presentation and save it as "slides.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a document with slide text from presentation. Evaluator verifies the file exists at the specified path and contains text extracted from the presentation slides. The getter extracts text from both the DOCX and the source PPTX, and the metric compares content similarity to ensure the slide text was properly extracted.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage - evaluator checks both file existence and content
Getter correctly extracts text from both DOCX (via <w:t> tags) and source PPTX (via <a:t> tags) using zipfile parsing
Metric compares DOCX content against presentation text using Jaccard similarity and coverage metrics
Requires 70% similarity to fully pass, with partial credit for 50-70% (reasonable threshold)
Postconfig appropriately activates window and saves file to ensure fresh state
Expected parameter handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly and accesses it properly (line 23)
Edge cases handled: empty text, missing presentation, file not found
All instruction requirements verified: file creation at correct path + slide text extraction
